result.query_rationale: The gap is the formal operation 'eliminate a single-valued node from a network, inducing effective couplings among its neighbors, and read off the resulting effective graph.' In established circuit/network theory this is node elimination via Schur complement / Kron reduction / star-mesh (Y-Delta) transform, and the hysteresis-specific counterparts live in the Preisach/hysteron-network, return-point-memory and renormalization literature. The two revised queries swap the case-specific paraphrase ('witness hysteron', 'manufacturing healing criterion') for short, established domain terms that would surface either the network-reduction foundation (Kron/Schur) or the Preisach/hysteron-network hierarchy papers the user needs to compare levels against.
